# Hanma Fitness Studio

> Coached gym in Gulistan e Johar (also spelled Gulistan e Jauhar), Karachi, Pakistan, serving Johar, Gulshan e Iqbal and East Karachi. Personal training, group training, women only hours, aerobics and Zumba, MMA, physiotherapy and diet plans under one roof. Rated 4.7 on Google. First session free.

## Key facts
- Address: Manzoor Street, Gulistan e Johar, Karachi
- WhatsApp and phone: +92 316 7911505
- Website: https://hanmafit.com
- Coached Monday to Friday; Saturday open floor; closed Sunday
- Mornings 7 to 11 am, coached by Faisal
- Women only, Monday to Friday, 1 to 5 pm: the whole studio is women only, coached by Samina
- Women only aerobics class, Monday to Friday, 5 to 6 pm, separate class room, with Samina
- Female coach Urooj Shehyr (Level 2 certified) on the main floor, Monday to Friday, 6 to 8 pm
- Evenings coached by Rafi and Khubaib
- MMA classes Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday with coach Owais
- Physiotherapist: Dr Ismail, DPT. Consultant dietitian: Arooba Nawaz
- Founder: Fawad Haris, BS Human Nutrition and Dietetics; coaches by appointment
- Open since 2023

## Prices (PKR)
- Basic membership: 7,000 a month, or 15,000 a quarter
- Group training: 12,000 a month, or 31,000 a quarter
- Personal training: 20,000 a month, or 51,000 a quarter
- Aerobics and Zumba: 5,000 a month
- MMA: 5,000 a month
- Day pass: 1,000
- Admission: 5,000 once, on monthly plans only; quarterly plans have no admission fee
- First session free
